gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-smooch-sans: Strokes like fine rope laid into letter shapes give Funnel Display a look that is all its own. And Smooch Sans, a sans-serif with a high midline, packs lines so tightly that paragraphs read as dense texture.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-victor-mono: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of unvarying width throughout. It excels at expressive, commanding display lettering, while Victor Mono, a monospace with loose spacing, excels at precise, structured text blocks.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough, a sans-serif, keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Winky Rough then reads brisk and contemporary across paragraphs, leaving Funnel Display to do the shouting with rope-like strokes.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-yantramanav: Funnel Display lays down spaghetti-like strokes of uniform width and a bold, expressive streak. And Yantramanav, a sans-serif whose lowercase nearly reaches the capitals, does the quieter job of carrying text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-plus-jakarta-sans: Fine rope turned into letters: that is Funnel Display at the top. Plus Jakarta Sans keeps a monoline plain sans build with curve endings well apart, so text flows smoothly as it runs on.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-quicksand: Terminals cut open so counters flow outward give Gabarito its one-nib, drawn look. Quicksand, a sans-serif with tall, bulb-like lowercase bowls, feels approachable, its terminals finishing well away from the stem.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-alan-sans: Cord-like curves and open-cut terminals are what expressive Gabarito does best. Alan Sans, a modern sans whose curve tails stay well back, does best at quietly carrying the text.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-albert-sans: Albert Sans keeps apertures open at tiny sizes, its plain sans strokes holding one thickness in every direction. Gabarito then adds the loud, expressive flourish that its open-cut terminals bring.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: A steady, unvarying line weight and one-nib look give Gabarito its expressive hand. But Alegreya Sans SC, plain sans in spirit, with a welcoming gap in the c, reads smoothly and openly as text accumulates.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-antic: Gabarito draws every letter with a one-nib look and terminals cut open. Antic, plain sans in class, shares that nib-drawn feel, its letter mouths open like a chalk arc left unjoined.
